title: feat(example-crm): business vocabulary on crm_opportunity_metrics (ADR-0149 D1)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi94CosmCy4wibc3rRg4ppMsN)_
Fixes #31591

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：给示例 CRM 的商机指标数据集（crm_opportunity_metrics）的 3 个维度和 3 个指标都写上业务定义（description）和用户常用说法（synonyms，中英混排，29 个），并补了中文翻译；hotcrm 的九个数据集另立了卡 objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2425。
- 为什么改：ADR-0149 要求 AI 通过数据集语义层回答业务问题，这是第一份真实词汇数据，也是 D5 问数准确率评测的「改前/改后」基线。
- 风险与回滚：只改示例元数据与它的测试，不发布任何包；回滚即还原这三个文件。
- 先看：`examples/app-crm/src/datasets/opportunity.dataset.ts`（总金额的定义：含在途、赢单、输单，既不是在途漏斗也不是已确认收入）、`examples/app-crm/src/translations/crm.translation.ts`、`examples/app-crm/test/smoke.test.ts`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/example-crm exec vitest run test/smoke.test.ts`，预期 24 个用例全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- `crm_opportunity_metrics`: every member (dimensions `stage`, `account`, `close_date`; measures `opp_count`, `total_amount`, `avg_amount`) gains a `description` written as a plain business definition (what it counts, what it excludes; ADR-0149 M1 ruled A, no model instructions) and `synonyms` a business user would type, English and Chinese in the one list (D1: synonyms are match input, never locale-keyed). Near-duplicates of the label were left out (no "total amount", "average deal size", "opportunities").
- Deliberate choice: a synonym that names a narrower meaning than the measure is a defect, not a style point (these are D5's first data). `total_amount` sums open, won and lost deals alike, so it carries no "revenue" / 「营收」 synonym and no "pipeline value" / 「漏斗金额」 synonym (in sales usage both mean a subset: won deals, open deals). Its description says it is neither the open pipeline nor booked revenue, and how to narrow it to each. `avg_amount` averages every stage, so it carries no 「平均成交额」 (成交 reads as won deals).
- zh-CN bundle: the spec card (#31587) made member `description` translatable at `datasets.NAME.{dimensions,measures}.MEMBER.description` (display text, like `label`) and gave `synonyms` no bundle key. Following that rule, each member description has its zh-CN translation; no synonym key was invented. The `en` block of this bundle has no `datasets` section today (the source metadata is English), so none was added.
- hotcrm half: filed as objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2425 through the relay (`issue-create.mjs`) with the same rules. Code search on hotcrm's default branch finds **nine** dataset files, not the eight the card names (`account_metrics`, `contact_metrics`, `event_metrics`, `forecast_metrics`, `lead_metrics`, `opportunity_metrics`, `task_metrics`, `case_metrics`, `product_metrics`); the card asks hotcrm's lane to confirm scope.

### D5 baseline (before / after, this dataset)

| | members | members with description | synonyms |
|---|---|---|---|
| before (`0105a687`) | 6 (3 dimensions, 3 measures) | 0 | 0 |
| after | 6 | 6 (+ 6 zh-CN translations) | 29 (stage 6, account 6, close_date 5, opp_count 5, total_amount 4, avg_amount 3) |

No member is left without synonyms.

## Tests

New top-level `describe` in `examples/app-crm/test/smoke.test.ts` (the example's shared harness file), read on the composed stack:

- the dataset passes `DatasetSchema.safeParse`, vocabulary `superRefine` included;
- every dimension and measure has a non-empty `description` and at least one synonym (member roster pinned);
- every member description has a non-empty zh-CN translation that is not the English text echoed.

No existing test was edited.

Ablation (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, each leg restored to blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty; example source runs under vitest directly, no dist leg):

- `stage` synonym `'sales stage'` → `'customer'` (collides with `account`'s synonym): the stack's own load refuses — file collection fails with `datasets.0.dimensions.1.synonyms.0: synonym "customer" of dimension "account" is also a synonym of dimension "stage" in this dataset …` (the composed stack parses before any `it` runs, so the refusal arrives one layer earlier than the new parse pin).
- delete `avg_amount`'s zh-CN `description`: `× translates every member description into zh-CN` — `AssertionError: avg_amount: expected false to be true`.
- delete `avg_amount`'s `synonyms`: `× gives every dimension and measure a description and at least one synonym` — `AssertionError: avg_amount: expected 0 to be greater than 0`.

## Acceptance notes

- Changeset: none, `skip-changeset`. `@objectstack/example-crm` is `private: true`; `.changeset/config.json` versions private packages (`privatePackages.version: true`) but the package publishes nothing, and its CHANGELOG has only ever carried dependency bumps. AGENTS.md reserves a changeset for a diff that publishes.
- Note for a later card, not changed here: `avg_amount`'s existing zh-CN label 「平均成交额」 reads as "average won-deal amount" while the measure averages every stage (open, won, lost). The label is out of this card's scope; a later card could relabel it 「平均商机金额」.
- The term matcher that reads `synonyms` (ADR-0149 D7 card 2, service-analytics) has not landed; until it does these keys are declared data with ledger rows `planned`, as D6 states.

## Verification

Head `2d04c9f8` (seat fix round 1 on top of `f17fabe3`: dropped three synonyms, reworded `total_amount`'s description in en and zh-CN; `f17fabe3` merged `origin/main`, touching no `examples/` or `packages/spec` file).
